name: myRev_append
prelude:
def myRev : List α → List α
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => myRev xs ++ [x]
statement: theorem myRev_append (xs ys : List α) : myRev (xs ++ ys) = myRev ys ++ myRev xs
proofs:
induction xs with
  | nil => simp [myRev]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [myRev, ih, List.append_assoc]
  induction xs with
  | nil => rw [List.nil_append, myRev, List.append_nil]
  | cons x xs ih => rw [List.cons_append, myRev, ih, myRev, List.append_assoc]
